designationHistory.indexText: Canaan Valley National Wildlife Refuge in Tucker County, West Virginia, was established when the Fish and Wildlife Service bought its first tract, 86 acres, with help from The Conservation Fund; it was the 500th national wildlife refuge.

authority.citation: Land acquisition (Emergency Wetlands Resources Act of 1986 and other authorities)

designationHistory.note: The CCP gives August 11, 1994 in one place and 'September 11, 1994' in another; the encyclopedia gives August 11, 1994. The refuge was formally dedicated as the 500th refuge on October 22, 1994 (FWS news release, Oct. 19, 1994: https://www.fws.gov/sites/default/files/documents/historic-news-releases/1994/19941019a.pdf).

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Canaan Valley NWR Comprehensive Conservation Plan, 2011 (ServCat 1398)
